# Orchestrator proxy checkpoint — 2026-10-07
Operator instruction: use aida-orchestrate, proxy routine backlog decisions until genuinely human-gated; adopt fix-day first. Authority-changing merges and protected decisions stay with Joe. Latest instruction supersedes earlier coordination-only/no-backlog scope; no permission or integrity floor is waived.
STATE: turn ends after this checkpoint; no child or watcher remains running from this turn. Do not imply background orchestration. Same conversation retains coordination/proxy responsibility; no successor/ownership transfer or rollover requested.

## Adopted FIRST
Draft PR https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2452 at eb96823bda625d6e343d8bfbab996585541d0a79, branch fix-day-2026-10-07, base 738653fb3e6de71d0975047adb143c5f31a25d85.
Final code/test SHA 7e007f83dcecced4da73b5f32838a63367db56f3. Only evidence docs differ at PR head. Coordinator verified 63/63 manifest hashes; implementer-reported workspace 9851 passed, zero failed, 7 ignored, fast 21 gates. No fresh coordinator test run or review approval.
One fresh strict whole-branch reviewer brief: .aida/handoff/orchestrator/review-2452.md; substrate pickup brief .aida/agent-briefs/codex/STORY-1537-2026-10-07T230836Z.md. STORY-1537 also routed reviewer and mailbox handed to backlog-reviewer. No reviewer is verified staffed. Attempted fix-day-final-review-2452 launcher exited 1 before vendor spawn: advisor grant does not delegate reviewer. No reviewer verdict created.
Required CI last observed: Build pending (run 37700234230), merge-hold-gate pass (37700234257), exact PR head. No running CI waiter. Operator-only merge for authority-sensitive changes. Existing PR-2445/2450 remain OPEN/held; do not close or clear until exact whole-branch review and operator adoption resolution. PR-2435 OPEN at 6fa035c26b735a9e7afc45bb1d2f0bba706144da, supervised refusal remains; duplicate removed with audit backup, no inferred provenance.
Two E2E sandbox runs remain unmeasured; prior attempts at c418c60fe7 were prelaunch dispatch refusals. Actual aggregate shipped=0, launch-refused not measured, other=2 driver refusals. Need runnable fixtures/isolation and validated driver/child delegation, final binary 7e007f83dc, before rerunning. Saved coordination measurement handoff remains .aida/handoff/advisor-burndown-coordination/20261007T164621Z.md. Do not count attempts as completed runs.

## Routine proxy decisions completed, audit on each spec
Promoted/adopted TASK-1337, TASK-1338, TASK-1339 as Approved under the operator-approved combined fix-day plan; NO duplicate implementation dispatch and NO Done/Completed credit. PR trailer lists these plus TASK-1603/TASK-1606.
Approved/queued TASK-1605 historical report and TASK-1329 Windows timeout on implementer role. Approved TASK-1332 writer-lock and TASK-1335 forge-unavailable reconcile explanation for SKETCH ONLY; independent author/signoff gate before queue/implementation. Sketch requests are spec comments.
Rejected TASK-1336 as obsolete missing --require-head premise: current cli.rs exposes it and lib.rs enforces wave freshness; STORY-1414 completed survivor; auto selection considers target/agent. No production freshness policy changed.
Deferred TASK-1326 (still Draft) until exact native Windows termination failure recurs. Approved/deferred SPEC-443 until existing native Windows runner can validate task_1597_delegation_prompt. Not completion credit. ALL 127 deferred entries/trigger and status inventory captured at .aida/handoff/orchestrator/deferred-20261007.json; older completed/rejected entries are historical, not new decisions. Existing deferrals not silently cleared.
Visible open board now 44: 31 Approved, 8 InProgress, 5 Draft. Full open snapshot .aida/handoff/orchestrator/open-board-20261007.json. Backlog NOT drained. Routine ready work remains blocked by common human launch/environment gates, not individually reclassified as protected decisions.

## Five remaining visible drafts, explicit protected questions
STORY-1527: readiness threshold/evidence product policy.
EPIC-74: branch vocabulary versus named lane, isolation/completion model across three guided children.
STORY-1486: launch writable roots/Git policy/approval exemptions; prerequisite hold expired, fresh operator decision recorded.
TASK-1609/TASK-1610: native platform identity probe enabling protected operations; parent TASK-1607 unmerged, native tests/independent sketch/operator merge required.
Existing TASK-1565 performance guard question remains pending, not answered by proxy. Existing guided/authority items (STORY-1217 TASK-1591 TASK-1593 BUG-1802 BUG-1808 TASK-1608 CR-7 TASK-1511 STORY-1484 and lane children) retain their prior sketch/hold/operator conditions; no permission-expanding auto-approval.

## Dispatch blockers verified
Current session validated advisor grant delegates ONLY advisor. No managed agent may issue a direct TTY grant. Reviewer launch refusal above is actual evidence.
Routine BUG-1807 launch attempted final branch binary with --strict --no-human=both --role implementer --user joe --no-pull. Exit 1 before vendor/session creation: read-only main .git prevents private fetch ref and fresh bug-1807 worktree branch ref; warm-pool acquisition also failed. Verified BUG-1807 remains Approved, queued implementer, no bug-1807 branch or new lease. Do not call this success or rerun in another session's occupied checkout. Restricted session grants read-only .git and source metadata; do not bypass via unsafe grant records, force, TTY spoofing or permission overrides.
Existing leases TASK-1607, TASK-1603/1338/1606/1337, TASK-1611 and ambiguous harness records untouched. ps reports dormant/stalled, NOT proof ownership is free. No duplicate implementation launched. docs/task-1611 has uncommitted work; no salvage edits performed by proxy.

## Exact human terminal next step
Use NORMAL operator terminal at /home/joe/ai/aida (not managed-agent shell). Use final binary path. Require successful role output before eval so failed diagnostics cannot reach eval (BUG-1806 remains pending):
role_updates="$(/home/joe/ai/aida-fix-day-2026-10-07/target/debug/aida role enter advisor --no-resume --delegate-seat advisor --delegate-seat implementer --delegate-seat reviewer --delegate-seat integrator)" && eval "$role_updates"
/home/joe/ai/aida-fix-day-2026-10-07/target/debug/aida agent new codex --role reviewer --name fix-day-final-review-2452 --prompt-file /home/joe/ai/aida/.aida/handoff/orchestrator/review-2452.md --no-resume
This launches only the independent reviewer; do not mark it staffed before launch acknowledgment. Human terminal/source environment must allow normal Git writes for sibling worktrees. Role grant is an actual protected issuance action; proxy did not mint it. A newly issued root grant does not retroactively alter this managed process environment; child grants do not inherit delegation. Do not assume a new advisor child can fan out further seats without a supported delegated chain.

## Next ordered actions
1. Collect independent reviewer acknowledgment/report for PR-2452; exact head, real tests and concrete findings. Missing reviewer delegation/Git permissions needs operator environment action; never self-review to avoid it.
2. Authorized sandbox driver + regression fixture recipe performs two final-binary measurements, acceptance verifier checks exact-SHA evidence. Required CI settles. Rework only through sole authorized implementation owner/new explicit handoff, not duplicate sessions.
3. Operator handles authority-sensitive fix-day merge/holds; routine backlog implementers then run queued bounded items in isolated worktrees through granted launchers, followed by fresh independent reviews and required exact-SHA CI. Sketch-gated store work waits independent signoff. Resolve five recorded protected forks only by Joe.
No merge, no hold clearance, no schedule enabled, no authority-changing proxy integration approval. No goal completion claim.
